epic.title: Epic #418 wave 3, dispatch W3-A (issue #465)
epic.intent_and_why: Close the gap between three instructions and the machinery behind them in skills/reviewer/ and scripts/checklist_engine.py: give the r6-fowler fill an engine verb and name it, stop the engine's own writer from rewriting line endings, and correct the SKILL.md sentence that contradicts the engine's --override-reason.

definition_of_done: amend's retext-check op runs on a survey checklist (add/drop/rescope stay gated-only)
save() preserves an existing file's line ending and writes bytes; new/mixed-ending files get LF
skills/reviewer/ r6-fowler names both the normal and repair paths; SKILL.md's override-reason sentence is corrected
the line-ending regression is proven red before green with both an LF and a CRLF fixture
full suite green alongside the four new named tests

good_enough.mandatory_quality: targeted tests for each of the three coupled changes plus the full suite, per ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT's mechanism-change bar
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: observed command results (refusals, red-before-green fixtures, full suite exit code), not structural assertion -- map is DEGRADED-NO-MAP
good_enough.appetite: one gate (g1), three coupled changes treated as one coherent bite

hard_constraints: two-bin rule: every enforced invariant is checked by a command or attested by a named human -- the r6-fowler command postcondition cannot simply be deleted
spine: read and change the checklist state only through the engine, never by hand

fence: only scripts/checklist_engine.py, skills/reviewer/**, and new tests under tests/ (plus the Admiral-ratified extension to docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md and skills/workbench/references/checklist-engine.md)
fixed_decisions: retext-check lifts to survey; add/drop/rescope stay gated-only
the engine writes bytes and preserves the existing line ending; LF and CRLF fixtures, red before green
the prose moves (SKILL.md's override-reason sentence), not the --override-reason affordance itself
docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md and skills/workbench/references/checklist-engine.md extension is ratified by the Admiral -- five statements there went false when the guard relaxed

current_wave.objective: Land the r6-fowler affordance gap, the line-ending byte-faithful save, and the two prose corrections as one reviewed, tested change
exit_criteria: implementer result integrated with no unresolved blockers
named new tests plus the full suite pass with a real exit 0
